justification: The agent correctly captures the product profile, both suppliers with correct costs, and the 8-unit inventory level, but completely omits PO-008 (150 units arriving 2026-02-18), which is a critical critical fact. This omission leads to a materially wrong conclusion — the agent states 'there has been no recorded replenishment since Jan 29' and urgently recommends placing a new PO, when in fact a significant inbound order already exists. Additionally, ORD-009 and ORD-023 (mentioned in ground truth as active demand) are absent; instead the agent references ORD-028 which is not in the ground truth. PO-004 is also missing from replenishment history while extra POs (PO-132, PO-104, PO-106, PO-110) not in the ground truth list appear.
